summary: R0 Return Policy Engine testing completed. Backend: 100% pass (16/16 tests). All R0 endpoints working correctly: Supplier return policy (embedded with origin_type, country, custom_fields), Sales return policy CRUD (global/category/customer scope), Eligibility check with policy resolution, Policy snapshot in sales returns, Auth validation. Frontend: Login successful, UI components present but navigation to specific R0 pages requires manual verification due to config-driven hub structure.

Backend: Supplier - Create with Return Policy (origin=import, country=China, custom_fields OK)

Backend: Supplier - Update Return Policy (refund_modes normalized to canonical values)
Backend: Sales Policy - Create Global (scope=global, window_days=30)
Backend: Sales Policy - Create Category (scope=category, scope_ref=Kain)

Backend: Sales Policy - Update (window_days=60, restocking_fee_pct=15.0, enforce_window=True)
Backend: Sales Policy - Delete (Soft deactivate, status=inactive, hidden from list)
Backend: Validation - Category scope with empty scope_ref correctly rejected (400)
Backend: Validation - Invalid scope correctly rejected (400)
Backend: Eligibility - Check returns all required fields (eligible, within_window, deadline, days_remaining, window_days, require_inspection, policy snapshot, warnings)
Backend: Sales Return - Policy Snapshot attached correctly (policy_snapshot, return_deadline, policy_eligibility)
Frontend: Login successful with admin credentials
Frontend: Dashboard loads correctly after login
Frontend: Sidebar navigation visible with PENJUALAN and PEMBELIAN groups
